description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusDao class, which provides data access methods related to EmploymentStatus entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employment status records in the database.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmploymentStatus entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmploymentStatus entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmploymentStatusIds
methods.description: Fetches existing EmploymentStatus IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Persists an EmploymentStatus entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes employment status records by their IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Searches for employment statuses based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusPaginator
methods.description: Builds a paginator object for employment status search results, with sorting and filtering.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching search criteria.
